title: VoxDSTAR landing page: choose the composition
question: The world is the app's own night display (black glass, Barlow, Share Tech Mono, cyan LINKED, green RX, red TX). Three page structures were dealt; lock one, steer, or re-roll.

options.label: Memory bank
options.lineage: the radio's own memory channels, stepped by the knob
options.thesis: The page is the radio's memory bank: scroll is the knob, and each feature is a channel.
options.viewport: Full-width display: status bar on top (signal, LINKED, CT7BLE), a giant mono readout M01 XLX268 E with the offer under it, a channel strip M01 to M07 down the right, softkey bar at the bottom whose right key is GET THE APK.
options.risk: Steps between channels must stay plain scroll and links, or it reads as a gimmick that hides content.

options.label: Radio in hand
options.lineage: a HYT-P50 held at near-life scale, keys called out
options.thesis: One push-to-talk radio at near-life scale with VoxDSTAR live on it; leader lines name the keys.
options.viewport: Radio right of centre bleeding off the bottom, display showing XLX268 E linked; offer set into the black at left; leaders to F2 PTT, knob MEMORY, SCREEN OFF STILL ON AIR; the download as a lit key.
options.risk: voxTetra-site already uses this form; the two sites would read as one template.

options.label: Last heard
options.lineage: the reflector's heard list and the app's RX panel
options.thesis: The page arrives as overs: an RX panel takes the top, and every section below is a line in the heard log.
materials: log rows with callsign, reflector, duration, BER
options.viewport: A full-width green RX panel: caller CT7BLE on XLX268 E, timer and BER, the offer as the slow-data message; below, heard rows begin, each one a feature; download sits in the status bar.
options.risk: Green everywhere tires; RX green must stay for one panel, rows stay black.
